verified_against: NREL/OpenStudio-server tag v3.11.0 (server/app/controllers/*.rb, config/mongoid.yml) + NatLabRockies/openstudio-server-helm develop branch + LIVE kind capture 2026-08-18 (docs/kind-validation.md)
purpose: Machine-readable distillation of the endpoint RESPONSE SHAPES the operator depends on. scripts/check_fixture_drift.py diffs captured fixtures (tests/fixtures/live/) and committed samples (tests/fixtures/samples/) against these shapes. Key semantics: required_keys/item_required_keys missing = DRIFT (fail); item_forbidden_keys present = DRIFT (fail); item_expected_keys missing = WARN (conditionally-populated key); extra keys = INFO (server richer than contract is normal for raw Mongoid docs).
live_verified_global_rules: mongoid.yml sets raise_not_found_error: false — Analysis#find returns nil instead of raising: unknown ids do NOT 404. page_data answers 200 {analysis: null}; status answers 200 with an empty plural wrapper.

Raw Mongoid docs (analyses.json, data_points.json) OMIT nil fields — an absent key is not a null key. A fresh analysis has NO status key until the workflow advances. DataPoint docs, in contrast, carry run_start_time/ip_address/job_id as explicit nulls before start.
Ids are UUID strings (mongoid uuid key), not BSON ObjectIds. Raw docs have _id only; the derived status views additionally duplicate it as id.

Content negotiation: endpoints with both HTML and JSON variants (action, requeue, DELETE) return the HTML variant (e.g. DELETE -> 302 redirect) unless the client sends Accept: application/json. The operator's JSON client sees the JSON shapes captured here; curl without -H 'Accept: application/json' does not.
page_data uses as_json(only: [...]) which drops nil fields — start_time is ABSENT (not null) until the first job runs. The SLA anchor must tolerate absence.

response.notes: Raw Mongoid docs; no derived methods. start_time is NOT a stored Analysis field - it only exists in page_data.json. status is ABSENT on a fresh analysis (nil field omitted); run_flag serializes even when false.

Wrapping is count-based (live-verified): exactly 1 match -> {analysis: {...}}; 0 or many -> {analyses: [...]}. exit_on_guideline_14 renders as an integer. jobs items: {index, analysis_type, status, status_message}; data_points items: {_id, id, name, analysis_id, status, status_message}. Uses where() (not find): unknown ids never 404, they yield the empty plural wrapper.

SLA clock anchor: analysis.start_time is derived from the first job and is ABSENT (nil-omitted by as_json) until then. Live-verified minimal analysis serializes as {name, data_points, results, output_variables} only.

Light watchdog poll. Rails quirk: presence of the status param gates filtering; the filter VALUE is read from jobs. No timestamps in this view - pair with operator-tracked startedSince (Q6). No matches -> {data_points: []} over 200 (where() query, never 404).

DataPoint.all - query params ignored (no server-side filter). Heavy; escalation-only. Live-verified: conditional keys are present-but-null before a worker picks the datapoint up; raw docs have _id only (no id duplicate). status starts at 'na' with status_message ''.

Cooperative stop; does NOT wait for in-flight runs. HTML-only action (respond_to has no format.json): live-verified 302 with an ABSOLUTE Location URL. The JSON-observable effect is run_flag flipping in later reads. Do NOT follow the redirect when capturing. Unknown ids ALSO 302 (controller nil-check redirects to /analyses).

Body carries the real status: {code: 200, analysis: {...}} on success, {code: 500, error: ...} on failure - both over HTTP 200. Live-verified: start on a seedless analysis STILL returns code 200 (failure surfaces later via the workflow); stop flips run_flag to false. Send Accept: application/json or the HTML variant redirects.

Destroys the existing Resque job, re-enqueues on the :requeued queue. Does NOT kill a wedged worker process (K8s-side escalation handles that). Live-verified trap: requeue on a datapoint with NO Resque job (never queued/started) returns 500 {status: 500, error: 'Internal Server Error'} - only requeue dps that have a job_id.

Cascades: data_points dependent:destroy; each dp after_destroy rm-rf's its NFS asset dir. This IS the NFS cleanup for the asset tree. Live-verified: 204 with Accept: application/json; 302 HTML redirect without it - always delete via a JSON client.
